limitations: Direct D6 call only. A wrapper transaction with multiple intent fills requires independently authenticated nested-call traces and deterministic per-event binding; it is rejected now.
Signed subaccountId proves an order-origin label but not a separate D4 economic account or historical membership of a local SQL subaccount row.
The canonical fee API is wallet-scoped. The current frontend does not call this endpoint or display its signed-origin metadata.
Only synthetic local receipts were tested. No public D6 intent settlement receipt is available in this evidence.
Indexer does not automatically ingest TradeExecutedFromIntents; operator-triggered admin reconciliation is required after D2 S2 proof.
The synthetic PostgreSQL test covers two signed wallet parties and wallet-scoped history; multiple economically separate local subaccounts are intentionally not attributed.
U256 intent fields exceeding backend u128 bounds are rejected, even if D6 could accept them.
next_action: Implement authenticated nested-call trace binding for multi-fill receipts and mount the wallet-scoped canonical fee view in a separately reviewed local frontend change; recheck D2 only after five independent S2 postflights.
